logline.ko: 스무 살, 다이어리 맨 윗줄에 '행복하게 살기'라고 적었다. 대학 합격, 장학금, 다이어트, 첫 월급, 졸업… 하나씩 이룰 때마다 형광펜을 그었지만, 기쁨은 잠깐이었고 목록은 끝없이 길어졌다. 다시 맨 윗줄로 돌아와서야 알았다. 그 모든 순간, 이미 행복하게 살고 있었다는 걸.
logline.en: At twenty, she wrote “Live happily” at the top of her diary. University, a scholarship, getting fit, a first paycheck, graduation — she highlighted each one, but the joy never lasted and the list only grew. Back at the top line, she finally sees it: she had been living happily all along.

text.ko: '행복하게 살기' 아래로 늘어나는 목록. 이룰 때마다 형광펜을 긋지만 기쁨은 잠깐이고, 마지막엔 맨 윗줄로 돌아온다
text.en: A list growing under “Live happily”: every goal gets highlighted, the joy fades, and the story ends back at the top line

text.ko: 달려 들어와 → 한 줄 쓰고 → 이루고 → 웃음이 사라지는 루프를 네 번, 갈수록 빠르게

prompts.text: 3D animated film style (warm Pixar-like), the young woman from the reference image: long straight dark-brown hair, brown eyes, oversized grey hoodie. Night, her small cozy student room lit by a desk lamp and fairy lights. She holds her phone close to her face, the screen glow lighting her. She reads it, freezes, gasps, then jumps up and cheers with both fists, beaming. Camera: medium shot, quick push-in to her face as she cheers. In the last two seconds her smile slowly fades into a worried, distant look and she lowers the phone. Sound: a phone notification chime, her gasp and happy shout, then quiet room tone. No text, no subtitles, no logos.

prompts.text: Use the attached image as the exact first frame. 3D animated film style, same character, same room, same lighting, static camera with the same framing for the whole shot. The young woman keeps running in a hurry from the doorway toward the desk on the right side of the room. Her face stays stressed, frowning and irritated the entire time, brows pulled together, lips pressed tight, out of breath - she never smiles. She reaches the desk, drops onto the chair and quickly grabs the yellow highlighter on the desk. Sound: dust and small debris settling behind her, fast footsteps on a wooden floor, her heavy breathing and one short frustrated sigh. No speech, no words, no music, no text on screen.

logline.ko: 바다숲이던 바위 하나가 하얗게 변하고, 사람이 해조류를 다시 심어 숲이 돌아오기까지. 마지막 장면이 첫 장면으로 이어져 끝없이 반복되는 29초.
logline.en: One boulder goes from kelp forest to white barren, then back after people replant it: 29 seconds that loop into their own beginning.

text.ko: Gemini 이미지로 바다숲 바위(A)를 만들고, 같은 채팅에서 구도를 지킨 채 하얀 바위(B) → 해조류 줄을 묶은 바위(C)로 편집

text.ko: A · B · C를 각각 첫 프레임으로 넣어 Veo 10초 영상 3개 생성 — 갯녹음 진행 / 손으로 심기 / 다시 자람
text.en: Three 10 s Veo clips, each starting from A, B or C — the barren spreading, hands replanting, the forest growing back

text.ko: Google AI Studio 음성 생성 · 목소리 Charon · 대본 6줄, 숫자는 한글로 적어 오독 방지

text.en: Color matched across the three clips, a loop that melts the last shot into the first frame, narration placed line by line with captions, and the underwater sound kept low — Claude with Python, FFmpeg and OpenCV

prompts.text:
Read aloud in Korean, in a calm, warm nature-documentary narrator voice. Unhurried, with a clear pause (about one second) between each line:

바다에도 사막이 생깁니다.
해조류가 사라진 바위를 하얀 석회조류가 덮는 것, 갯녹음입니다.
수온 상승과 성게의 과도한 증가가 원인으로 꼽힙니다.
그래서 사람들이 해조류를 다시 심습니다.
바다숲 열일곱 곳에서, 해조류 무게는 백삼십팔 퍼센트 늘었습니다.
바다숲은, 다시 자랍니다.

text.ko: 바다에도 사막이 생깁니다. 시작은 해조류와 물고기가 사는 바위 하나.
text.en: Deserts form in the sea, too. It starts with one boulder full of kelp and fish.

text.ko: 해조류가 사라진 바위를 하얀 석회조류가 덮는 것, 갯녹음.
text.en: Kelp disappears and white coralline algae covers the rock: a sea barren.

text.ko: 수온 상승과 성게의 과도한 증가가 원인으로 꼽힙니다.
text.en: Rising water temperature and too many sea urchins are named as the main causes.

text.ko: 그래서 사람들이 해조류를 다시 심습니다.
text.en: So people plant seaweed again.

text.ko: 최근 4년간 완료한 바다숲 17곳, 해조류 무게 138% 증가.
text.en: 17 sea forests completed in the last four years: seaweed weight up 138%.

text.ko: 바다숲은, 다시 자랍니다. 그리고 영상은 첫 장면으로 돌아갑니다.
text.en: Sea forests grow back. And the video returns to its first frame.

Full body, 3/4 view, centered, photorealistic with cute character appeal, soft cinematic light, 16:9, no text, no logos, no subtitles.

prompts.text: Use the attached photo as the first frame and keep the same woman, hoodie, desk and room. Vertical 9:16, 8 seconds, cinematic realism, night. Her plain black smartphone on the desk starts vibrating and its screen glows bright neon green, lighting her face from below. The desk lamp flickers, a pen rolls off the desk, the whole room trembles slightly with slow heavy footsteps outside. She slowly lifts her head and turns toward the window, eyes widening. Sound: phone buzzing on wood, then deep distant footsteps growing louder. No on-screen text, no letters, no logos, no brand names.

prompts.text: Vertical 9:16, 6 seconds, night, cinematic realism. Extreme close-up, slightly high angle, of a plain black smartphone lying face-up on a wooden dorm desk next to textbooks and a pen, warm desk-lamp light. The phone buzzes and vibrates on the desk, then its whole screen lights up with one flat, solid, bright green color — a completely blank green screen with no icons, no text, no UI, no notifications. The green glow spreads over the desk. Slow push-in, phone stays in frame. Sound: phone vibrating on wood. No text, no letters, no logos.

A gift box as tall as a skyscraper, glossy neon green with a wide violet-purple ribbon and bow, walks on two short stubby legs between Seoul apartment towers, each step a gentle thud, glowing from inside, searchlights sweeping across it. People on balconies cheer and film with their phones, confetti drifting. Low angle from the street, slow push-in, volumetric light, joyful awe. Sound: deep soft footsteps, wind, a cheering crowd. No text, no letters, no logos.

The camera is behind her, over her shoulder, inside her small dorm room. She faces the door with her back to the camera, grabs the handle and swings the door open: the hallway outside is filled wall-to-wall with neatly stacked glossy neon green parcels with violet-purple ribbons. She freezes for a moment, then turns her head back toward the camera, eyes wide, and laughs in disbelief. Sound: door creak, a cheerful chime, soft laugh. No text, no letters, no logos.
